image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a Great White Pelican floating on dark water. The bird is facing left, with its head turned slightly towards the viewer. Its massive bill and gular pouch are prominent features. The plumage is predominantly white with some visible darker flight feathers underneath the folded wing. The water surface shows ripples and reflections.
